scope: Proposition 6.3 (Recognition of good subfields) of the manuscript “Reconstruction of Function Fields from Mod-ℓ Milnor K-Theory” (preprints/Reconstruction-of-Function-Fields-from-Mod-ell-Milnor-K-Theory-October-5-2026/mod-ell-bogomolov-pop.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 009 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 fafdf71eafc4700a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The curve-subfield correspondence of Theo- rem 5.4 restricts to a bijection on good subfields. For matched good subfields E ⊂ K and P ⊂ L, the induced character isomorphism gives a bijection between the points of their smooth projective rational curves.
